plan.p0: Mechanism: Find every 3×3 window consisting entirely of 0s, and recolor the union of all such windows to 1. Distinguishing assumption: overlapping windows are all retained, so their combined footprint can be wider than 3×3.
plan.p1: Mechanism: Treat maximal axis-aligned blank rectangles of at least 3×3 as objects and recolor each object to 1. Distinguishing assumption: rectangle interiors, rather than individual qualifying windows, determine the result; behavior may differ around irregular or overlapping blank regions.
plan.p2: Mechanism: Detect uniform 3×3 patches, but recolor them only when their common value is the grid’s dominant background color, inferred here as 0. Distinguishing assumption: uniform 3×3 patches of non-background colors are ignored.
plan.p3: Mechanism: Detect 3×3 regions that are nearly blank—allowing at most one nonzero cell—and recolor the whole region to 1. Distinguishing assumption: the transformation is tolerant of one defect, so future near-squares could be marked even when they are not perfectly zero.
